Planner gate runs — bump this file to start one.

run 9 — Part A1, PR #137. Run 8 reached 63 of 65 with zero timeouts, so
the 4 s cap is right: per-call p95 2,797 ms, slowest 3,681 ms — the tail
that the 3 s cap used to truncate is now visible and inside the cap.

Both remaining failures were angle-distinctness on pointer questions,
and one had a real cause: "SB 1.2.6" tokenises as four content words
{sb,1,2,6}, so two angles that merely both cite the verse share four
tokens and read as identical. A reference is now one token.
